svg.title: Independent butterfly records and mapped host resources
svg.desc: A: raw recorded share points and source-refit adjusted recorded and potential shares for the same 84 regions. B: monarch introduced-only host geography and records, with a named endemic feeding example. C–F: original independent prediction scores and adverse transfer.
svg.text: 4 | From mapped host opportunities to recorded butterflies
Separate observational and predictive outcomes; no claim of colonization or demographic gain.
Effort-restricted results uncertain; dots sized by record-unit count.

svg.text: Pieris cheiranthi larvae on introduced Tropaeolum majus;
Tenerife and La Palma; native Crambe also documented.
Region markers, not record coordinates or transport routes.
≥100 km is a subset, not an independent fit.
Known-host flora added after other alien flora.
Positive average; not universal across divisions.
Full four-stratum comparison remains in SI S5.1.
A: back-transformed equal-region fitted log odds at mean covariates; raw dots and quartile totals use recorded units.
B: simplified GSHHG coastline; mapped current hosts and 2001–2024 indices are not dated colonization evidence.
C–F: within-model relative MSE reductions; negative values indicate poorer predictions. Do not pool populations.
